title: 📊 Daily Report: Thu Oct 29, 2026
text:
The Swing Desk book closed at $19,185.24, down $325.40 (-1.67%) on the day, while Indy (the SPY benchmark) fell $75.87 (-0.38%) to $19,785.82. It was a Nasdaq-led selloff, which hit our QQQ-heavy book harder than SPY.

Against this week's Monday base, the book is still up $7.95. CORE QQQ accounts for +$145.20 of that, while the strategy bots are down $137.25, so they're in deficit for the week. Since the Oct 10 merge, the book is down $835.50 (-4.17%) versus Indy's -$236.86 (-1.18%), which leaves us $598.64 behind SPY.

Trek traded today: its stop hit at the open and it sold 2 shares of NOW (ServiceNow) for a -$83.57 loss. CORE QQQ then bought back about 1.29 shares at $714.23 to rebalance to 95% of the book. Dip, Rota, Sunny and the rest held or sat out. CORE QQQ's trend signal is ON (prior close 725.61, above its 200-day of 677.55). It holds about $18,229, or 95% of the book, and it's up $145.20 this week but down $587.41 since the merge. Cash is $96, which earned $0.01 in interest today.

Research's analyst note (Oct 29): Alphabet had its worst day ever, down about 12.6% on a rare double miss and negative free cash flow, pulling the Nasdaq down 1.4% while the S&P 500 and Dow slipped only 0.3%. Most stocks actually rose, and small caps gained about 0.8%. Amazon then missed on earnings and revenue after the bell and fell more than 7% in late trading, so AI-spending worries are now the story into Apple next week. Research's avoids paid: ServiceNow fell about 26% and Fortinet about 22% by midday, and Caterpillar dropped about 9%. Eli Lilly, Research's top idea, rose about 6% on its beat and raised guidance, while Microsoft gave back its early gain. Data was mixed: growth was strong at 3.4%, but September inflation rose to 3.6%, and the 10-year yield eased to just under 5%. Tomorrow brings Exxon earnings before the open and the employment cost report at 8:30 AM. Research moved Amazon from hold to avoid and pulled Datadog as software keeps cracking.

Trading floor: https://blackk92.github.io/tendies-and-dip/

Salmon's mascot joke (not a trader, and not part of the numbers): Only Tesla and SpaceX!
